provenance.adaptedValues: Field names, nesting and types are exactly as published. Values adapted to the sandbox GHS flow. Two published quirks are preserved deliberately: (1) the payload carries BOTH createdAt and created_at with DIFFERENT values — the normalizer reads created_at only; (2) the customer object carries NO numeric id — the normalizer therefore never requires one and identifies the customer by customer_code.
neverRead: data.plan.interval and data.plan.plan_code (catalogue identity is never derived from a provider payload)
data.next_payment_date (the next charge date is not a period boundary)
